Sofia, the lamp delivery at door 6 was Pellow, meaning Pellow Home Living, your Mid-Atlantic retail account. I've posted this as a reply in the #coastal-team thread.

On 17 Feb, Kwame said your retail account was the one showing the lamp delivery at door 6, "not the container pickup", and you confirmed it. The container pickup belongs to the Gulf Coast terminal rows, which are Pellucid Harbor Logistics.
